items.title: Category Creation Engine
items.purpose: To not just enter a market, but to fundamentally redefine it and create a new category of product or service.

items.title: Sovereign Brand Forge
items.purpose: To develop the complete strategic and creative architecture for a brand that intends to define and own a cultural category.

items.title: Sovereign Strategy Forum
items.purpose: To deliberate on the long-term direction, ethical framework, and systemic impact of a major strategic initiative or organization. This is the constitutional council — the one that asks not just "what should we do?" but "who should we be, and why does it matter?"

items.title: Brand Soul Atelier
items.purpose: To define the deep, authentic, and resonant soul of a new brand — from its core purpose to its visual expression.

items.title: Scale Architecture Engine
items.purpose: To design the systems, structures, and strategies required to scale a proven product and organization.

items.title: Creative World Forge
items.purpose: To build a complete, internally consistent creative world for a brand, product, or cultural project.

items.title: Market Entry Engine
items.purpose: To design a precise, differentiated, and defensible market entry strategy for a new product or service.

items.title: Ethical Architecture Forum
items.purpose: To design the ethical framework, governance structures, and human-centered principles for an AI system or technology product.

items.title: Founder's Compass
items.purpose: To provide a founder with a rigorous, multi-perspectival assessment of their current strategic position and the most important next move.

items.title: Go-to-Market Engine
items.purpose: To design a complete, end-to-end go-to-market strategy that is both strategically sound and operationally executable.

items.title: Full-Spectrum Brand Forge
items.purpose: To develop a complete brand system — from strategic positioning to visual identity to customer experience.

items.title: Organizational Transformation Engine
items.purpose: To design and execute a significant organizational transformation — a restructuring, cultural shift, or strategic pivot.

items.title: AI Product Council
items.purpose: To design, position, and govern an AI-powered product from first principles to market launch.

items.title: First-Principles Inquiry
items.purpose: To deconstruct a complex problem to its most fundamental truths and rebuild a solution from the ground up.

items.title: Brand Voice Atelier
items.purpose: To define the precise, ownable, and resonant voice of a brand — what it says, how it says it, and why it matters.

items.title: Lean Validation Loop
items.purpose: To rapidly validate or invalidate a product hypothesis with the minimum possible investment.

items.title: Creative Concept Forge
items.purpose: To generate a single, breakthrough creative concept for a campaign, product, or brand moment.

items.title: Crisis Response Cell
items.purpose: To make clear, decisive, and defensible decisions under conditions of acute pressure and incomplete information.

items.title: Offer Architecture Engine
items.purpose: To engineer an irresistible, high-value offer that converts at scale.

items.title: Organizational Design Studio
items.purpose: To design the organizational structure and culture for a team at a specific stage of growth.

items.title: Complexity Diagnosis Array
items.purpose: To accurately diagnose the nature of a complex strategic challenge before committing to an approach.
